summary: Update equipment timecard entry approval status
description: Update approval status of equipment timecard entries (pending, approved, reviewed, billed) for the given project. Supports bulk updates: pass an array of equipment timecard entry IDs and the desired approval_status. Billed entries cannot be changed to another status (except to keep as billed). Requires project timesheet approval permission.

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description: Optional response blueprint view. Defaults to `default`.

200.description: Equipment timecard entries approval status updated successfully. Returns the updated entries in the v2 data envelope.

id.description: Primary key (REST v2 serializes numeric identifiers as strings)

approved_by_id.description: Login that approved the entry, when applicable

approval_status_updated_at.description: When approval status was last updated

client_local_id.description: Client-provided local identifier echoed in API responses for request/response correlation.

equipment_name.description: Display name from Equipment Register when available (company-scoped list).

equipment_identification_number.description: Identification number from Equipment Register when available (company-scoped list).

origin_data.description: ERP / external integration payload from associated external_data

origin_id.description: External system identifier from associated external_data

timesheet.description: Present when serializer_view=mobile; nested timesheet (TimesheetBlueprint normal view). Null when the entry has no timesheet.

timesheet_status.description: Present when serializer_view=mobile; same as timesheet.status when a timesheet is associated

400.description: Invalid approval_status value or empty ids array. Valid statuses are pending, approved, reviewed, billed.

403.description: Forbidden. User does not have permission to approve equipment timecard entries.

404.description: One or more equipment timecard entries not found or do not belong to the project.

422.description: Unprocessable entity. For example, attempting to change billed entries to a different status.

ids.description: Array of equipment timecard entry IDs to update

approval_status.description: The approval status to set for all specified entries
